description:
19th October – Gifting and Packing Artsy Workshop
It gives immense joy and happiness to share that our member Asma Unwala added a lot of sparkle to the lives of the women at Kshmata this festive season by conducting a gifting and packing artsy workshop and they shared their love back!
Her family sponsored a bag full of ribbon, laces, patches, teaching them how to make torans, & various other products for Diwali gifting. There were about 20 girls who attended. Also taught how the items could be used in wedding gifting like candle packaging, arranging and making wedding bell sticks when the bride and groom enter. And how simple potli can be turned to a gift-able product with multiple items like gotta patti patches, and stones.
The ribbons and laces were sponsored by her family.
They also wanted help to know how to package their upcoming project as the girls will be making chocolates at Kshamata. They were also taught how to gift pack chocolates.
Beneficiaries 20
Project cost Rs 5,000/-
